notes.title: Celebrate Toge Productions 16th Anniversary with Coffee Talk!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/fbb3b087f0e37a41cf8815105fd0dc8c90769342.png[/img]

[h3][i]Greetings, Cafe Regulars.[/i][/h3]
[b]Happy New Year! We hope you all have a great time.[/b]

[i]Let's welcome the new year of 2025! We are starting with the excitement of The Toge Productions' 16th Anniversary, where we revealed new updates and amazing news to start the year. [/i]

[h3]Toge Productions 16th Anniversary Event is underway![/h3] 
The release timeline announcement for our latest titles is made during Toge Productions' 16th Anniversary Event, which is ongoing! You can check out other exciting news from Toge Productions that you can look forward to this year. Don't miss out on the excitement!

[h3]Watch Toge Productions 16th Anniversary Direct here![/h3] [previewyoutube=Lp6GDHcyNqc;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]The Toge Productions 16th Anniversary Event is happening now until January 24, 2025! [/b]Check out the newly announced games and enjoy discounts of up to 85% on individual titles and bundles. We’re excited to continue bringing enjoyable games for everyone to play. 

[b]You can learn more about the Toge Productions Anniversary Event here![/b]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/togeproductions/sale/togesale2025][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5485678/eddf3a9ce36a1473f32fbf994fafb0496ab7b92e.png[/img][/url]

[h3][b]The Coffee Talk series is expanding with a spin-off.[/b][/h3]
After releasing Coffee Talk and Coffee Talke Episode 2: Hibiscus & Butterfly, we collaborated with our friends at Chorus Worldwide to work on a new title. The title, Coffee Talk Tokyo, was teased last year and was the fruition of collab. This next project will act as a spin-off in the Coffee Talk series.

[h3][b]It's a small cafe at the back of a skyscraper.[/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3161220/Coffee_Talk_Tokyo/

For now, you can enjoy Coffee Talk and Coffee Talk Episode 2 as they are on sale during the Toge Productions 16th Anniversary Event! It's never too late to start playing the Coffee Talk series and know the diverse cast of fantastical characters. Check off your wishlist or grab a copy for your friends so they know the warm fuzzy feeling of Coffee Talk!

[h3]Toge Productions 16th Anniversary Event. 
Grab the Coffee Talk series—now on sale![/h3]

[h3][b]Coffee Talk is now 50% OFF![/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/914800/Coffee_Talk/

[h3][b]Coffee Talk Episode 2 is now 30% OFF![/b][/h3]
[h3][i]Grab the next episode In the series![/i][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1663220/Coffee_Talk_Episode_2_Hibiscus__Butterfly/

[h3][b]Coffee Talk The Complete Series is 45% OFF![/b][/h3]
[h3][i]Start the coffee-making and heart-to-heart talks in a bundle![/i][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28476/Coffee_Talk_Episode_1__2__Complete_Series/


[h2]Coffee Talk x Makeship Aqua Plush Collab is Now Live![/h2]
The cute and adorable shy lady, the Aqua Plush, can be your companion during your busiest days. Aqua exclusive plush [b]can only be pre-ordered during this period.[/b] After the campaign, you won't have any way to obtain the plush officially. So be sure to make your choice before the campaign period ends!
[h2][url=https://www.makeship.com/products/aqua-plushie]Aqua Plush Campaign Page[/url][/h2]

[h3]Researcher by day, aspiring indie dev by night.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/12c0ec0382034aa3173949c2110f82cf4274cb72.png[/img]

[h3][b] The campaign starts from January 31, 2025, to 31 January 2025[/b]. A one-time opportunity that won't come twice! [/h3]

[b][h3]A researcher, part-time indie game designer, pursuing her goal![/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/347220f686e0963cdcde8d6a946ecb845cbdae2b.gif[/img]



[h3][b]In loving memory of Fahmi.[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/5b16dfc191e4daf0a831379b241e3ea0e5b5d1be.png[/img]

Mohammad Fahmi Hasni, the original writer and creator of Coffee Talk, passed away in 2022. He also founded the indie studio Pikselnesia, which developed the title Afterlove EP. Despite being heartbroken by his passing, the Pikselnesia team poured their hearts and finished the game until the end. Afterlove EP honors Fahmi's vision and passion for storytelling. It is a labor of love and a personal journey presented from Pikselnesia.

[i]The team recently announced that Afterlove EP will be released on February 2025, during Valentine's Day.[/i]

[h3][i]Afterlove EP is coming out on February 14, 2025.[/i][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1599780/Afterlove_EP/



Wishing you all the best as we enter 2025!
We look forward to another great year together with everyone.
Thank you for your support, and stay tuned for more news soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/e565fd8faadca2dec71f42166fbf7a66cec63a48.png[/img][url=https://twitter.com/coffeetalk_game][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/2b28706cd5011db32da556bf6d3904e2bac01201.png[/img][/url][url=discord.gg/toge][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/189cd02729137419677e69173cf1602a0c487386.png[/img][/url]

Please stay safe and healthy, friends!
Fully brewed with love,

Coffee Talk Team. ːctfreyaː

notes.title: Toge Productions and Chorus Worldwide are brewing Coffee Talk Tokyo
notes.content:
Crave for more stories from the Coffee Talk customers?
[b]Toge Productions and Chorus Worldwide together are brewing a new spin-off story of Coffee Talk![/b]

[previewyoutube=m7a7og3e4fY;full][/previewyoutube]

Coffee Talk Tokyo is the next installment of the Coffee Talk series. It will take you to an all-new - but strangely familiar - all-night coffee shop, this time in a Tokyo backstreet. With a cast of new characters (and one or two familiar faces), Coffee Talk Tokyo will introduce you to new themes and storylines.

Once again taking on the role of Barista, you will take drink orders from customers like Kenji, a traditional kappa salaryman facing a life of retirement, Vin, the Barista’s assistant struggling with the daily consequences of a past catastrophe, and Ayame, a spunky ghost trying to move on with her (after)life.

Wishlist [b]Coffee Talk Tokyo[/b] now and follow on Steam to stay updated!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3161220/Coffee_Talk_Tokyo/


[h1]And if you're coming to PAX West this weekend...[/h1]

We'll have a booth at PAX West where we'll sell merchandise of Coffee Talk.
Be sure to come and visit our booth!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/be1d981cd74eff3bed6d5effd1b334d8c816b29b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Coffee Talk Characters Mod Update is Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/b466899dacaccd2b32c315c67406b04fef6ae6b1.png[/img]

[h2]Get creative with your favorite Coffee Talk regulars with the [i]Characters Mod![/i][/h2]

[h3]Greetings, Cafe Regulars.[/h3]
[b][i]The additional modding tool for Coffee Talk characters is now released.[/i][/b]

Just like in the recent update for Episode 2, the same update also arrived in Coffee Talk. Now, you can mod the game characters by changing the files accordingly. Access to the modding tool is available like other mods that had been implemented such as the localization and the voice-over mod. Change the character's overall outfit, modify their body parts, or add some cool or cute accessories to them!

[h3]The workshop tool, with the new characters mod, is out now![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/a052dca4c4786481595150f05f957b0424ca97dd.gif[/img]

We always listen to our fans and let them express what they have in mind, nurturing their creativity and love towards the characters and the game. With the arrival of the characters' mod update, we hope to brew more creativity for our fans to come up with interesting ideas that we might never have thought of before. If you never touched the mods for Coffee Talk, you can check the workshop documentation for the Coffee Talk series from the link down below. 

[h3][url=https://togepresskit.notion.site/Coffee-Talk-Ep-2-Modding-Tutorial-432ad3476b17475689743558fd1256f8]Coffee Talk Series Modding Tutorial[/url][/h3]
Workshop documentation and guide [url=https://togepresskit.notion.site/Coffee-Talk-Ep-2-Modding-Tutorial-432ad3476b17475689743558fd1256f8]here.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/c4071821faf43ee9f070a72b85189890207dcfa5.gif[/img]
Freya, with her basic shirt now changed to green, and you can still add more stuff to her! This is just the basic mod of what you can do. 

If you encounter any bugs after the new characters' mod update, don't hesitate to contact us or join our Discord community. You can also reach us from social media to get the latest news of Coffee Talk updates. We will always serve more stuff that you can look forward to!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/b04803d97bba2e533ae8ee041af697b669218945.png[/img][url=https://twitter.com/coffeetalk_game][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/79dd3f2effac213f7a4d79409aa7b3a3427c939d.png[/img][/url][url=discord.gg/toge][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/8b1312b21a87946f96f4f0f6eaabe151fe9fa95c.png[/img][/url][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/84fedc2164e8a93f749f967a579a4dd488b8b784.png[/img]

Please stay safe and healthy, friends!
Fully brewed with love,

Coffee Talk Team. ːctfreyaː

notes.title: Brew Your Favorite Coffee, Now Verified on Steam Deck!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/2deb82253e0fa6e211a811b028e32eb38ed282b2.png[/img]

[h2]Coffee Talk is now Steam Deck Verified[/h2]
[b]Coffee Talk has recently got the verified status on Steam Deck!✅[/b] and chatting. Now, everyone can fully experience playing the game on Steam Deck. Compatibility checks for the game had been successfully fulfilled, ensuring a delightful cozy time playing the game on the Deck. Experience playing as the barista on the go, brew your favorite coffee recipe and chat with the regulars anywhere and anytime you like with the Steam Deck.

[h3]Toge Productions goes to PAX East 2023![/h3]
This year, Toge Productions will go to Boston to open a booth at PAX East 2023. We also will bring Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus & Butterfly, the direct standalone sequel to Coffee Talk. If you are planning to come to PAX East, be sure to visit us, and you might receive a special treat! The Toge Productions crew will come to attend the booth, and we are looking forward to meeting you!

[h3][b]Wishlist and Follow Coffee Talk Episode 2 on Steam![/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1663220/Coffee_Talk_Episode_2_Hibiscus__Butterfly

[b]Follow us on social media and join our community to get into the game's latest updates. [/b] It's less than a few months before we release the sequel, expect more teasers and announcements. We are excited to hear your response to the upcoming release of the sequel.

[i]If you encounter any bugs while playing using the Steam Deck, please report it to us via [url=https://discord.gg/toge]Discord[/url] for faster inquiries.[/i]

Have you known that Coffee Talk is getting a new episode titled Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus and Butterfly? It's a direct continuation and a standalone game from the original Coffee Talk, and is planned to be released next year. The new episode contains new stories, new features, and new characters while still bringing all the awesome stuff from Coffee Talk!

[h3]Wishlist the next Coffee Talk episode here![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1663220/Coffee_Talk_Episode_2_Hibiscus__Butterfly/

This year, we have more offline events to attend, bringing you the goodness of the upcoming Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus and Butterfly demo. We are excited and grateful at the same time that we can visit different events, making our game one step closer to our fans around the world! 

[h3]Our booth at PAX West 2022![/h3]

PAX West 2022 is happening from [b]September 2 to September 5 at Seattle Convention Center,  Washington, United States.[/b] Visit and play the demo of Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus and Butterfly during PAX West 2022 at [b]Chorus Worldwide Games booth, booth no.850.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/1726fb92b09e8a9a8174f916c729872849c75945.jpg[/img]

Chorus Worldwide booth will showcase Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus and Butterfly and other titles such as Frank and Drake, Varney Lake, Read Only Memories: NEURODIVER, and Paper Ghost Stories: Third Eye Open. Be sure to check them all out!

[h3]Our booth at Busan Indie Connect Festival 2022![/h3]

Busan Indie Connect 2022 is happening from [b] September 1 to September 4 at BPEX, Busan, South Korea.[/b] Visit and play the demo of Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus and Butterfly at [b]Booth H-05[/b]. You can refer to the map below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/d1ccfd328461d2a892567e868f56ec0a27799281.png[/img]

Meet some of our lovely Toge crews attending the booth at BIC 2022. We can't wait and meet our fans. It would be great to hear your impression, opinion, and feedback about the game! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/8912d474024768b014d4bebf7c2bc0b298586108.jpg[/img]

[i]Come and visit us, bring your loved ones, friends, and families, and try the Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus & Butterfly demo! [/i]

Feel free to post your experience and tag us on our [url=https://twitter.com/coffeetalk_game]social media[/url], so we know you attended the booth! You might just be in for a surprise~ ːctcoffeeː

notes.title: Coffee Talk 2nd Anniversary!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/19d6fadbd789e784139a51341d2f1913cccde837.png[/img]

Greetings, fellow Cafe Regulars. 

Happy second year anniversary to Coffee Talk, the game we all know and love!
Especially to you all Cafe Regulars who've been with us, we are truly thankful for your support. We've been through a lot together, lots of great memories, and we feel like we could connect with you all through Coffee Talk.

After two years, there are many things that we have achieved together. Let's take a look, shall we? 

[h2]Coffee Talk finally open for business in 2020... [/h2]
Coffee talk was released two years ago, exactly on [b]January 29 2020.[/b] It's such a big day for us where we released Coffee Talk simultaneously on different PC platforms and consoles! The game was well-received by many players around the world. A few months after, we announced [url=https://twitter.com/coffeetalk_game/status/1255149778129879040?s=20]the Coffee Talk Collector's Edition[/url] with the help from our friends at [url=https://store.strictlylimitedgames.com/collections/coffee-talk]Strictly Limited Games and Chorus Worldwide.[/url] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/643caf05383c0f559949cd6cb9d0bb790a9854c1.png[/img]
[i]Coffee Talk collector's edition and all the goodies![/i]

There are lots of players who love the music of Coffee Talk, thus we decided to release the [url=https://twitter.com/coffeetalk_game/status/1318567650361069571]LP record of Andrew Jeremy's Coffee Talk greatest hits[/url] back in [b]October 2020, [/b]in collaboration with [url=https://blackscreenrecords.com/products/coffee-talk-official-soundtrack]Black Screen Records.[/url]. Everyone just loves vibing to Lo-Fi Hip Hop soundtrack while relaxing or just doing stuff, don't you think? ;)

[i][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/19b70143f17b2b190241a6d6ec9885c7d029550a.png[/img]
The vinyl came with the [url=https://twitter.com/blackscreenrec/status/1463462847153946624?s=20]Matcha Green and Coffee Brown double combo![/url][/i]

A few months after the vinyl release, we announced the[url=https://sanshee.com/collections/coffee-talk] first official Coffee Talk merchandise and collectibles[/url] on Sanshee in [b] December 2020.[/b] You were able to [url=https://twitter.com/TeamSanshee/status/1334210039247200258/photo/1]get it in a bundle[/url] if you want to collect everything on the list!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/199252fa630fbed71a31e9924cdb7926047f19f1.png[/img]
[i]What a gorgeous bundle of collectibles~[/i]

[h2]Coffee Talk continued to strive even better in 2021! [/h2]

During our first anniversary in [b]January 2021,[/b] we added mod support to the game. It was a big milestone for us to support the dedicated players, where localization and voice over mod were implemented! This is a mod that really brings more opportunity to our community. They can took part in adding their own language support and custom voice overs so more people can enjoy Coffee Talk as well!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/8525d05022f317fc6a1ce74bbdb6ce342d1e1126.gif[/img]

In the same month as the first anniversary of Coffee Talk, we were chosen as the finalist [b][i]Outstanding Achievement for an Independent Game[/i][/b] during [url=https://sea.ign.com/sea-indie-games/168111/news/coffee-talk-is-sole-southeast-asian-game-nominated-for-dice-awards]the 24th D.I.C.E Award[/url] back in [b]January 2021?[/b] It's a huuuge achievement for us to be recognized at such an grand event.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/9eeab1cd18210ccfefe95a26362ce6e4cf811684.png[/img]

The Coffee Talk OST Vinyl we released back in 2020 got a repress in [b]April 2021![/b] Not only that, Black Screen Records also released another version [url=https://blackscreenrecords.com/products/coffee-talk-original-soundtrack]of a beautiful 2xCD set[/url], definitely a treat for those who don't have a turntable. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/66223ebfb32e786a6ea7b47b68f28d74c49bd535.png[/img]
[i]The 2xCD set contain 22 tracks and 2 bonus tracks![/i]

In the SEA Game Awards Level Up KL 2021, we won the Grand Jury Award! If you didn't know, SEA Game Awards is one of the biggest game nomination event in Southeast Asia, and that's already a huge achievement for us as an indie game developer! We were just as amazed as everyone else when we watched the nomination back in [b]November 2021![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/6f0b9d06eb0777d74e0f31410ea089e3b95a22bf.png[/img]

The overwhelming support of the players for the past years pushed us even higher, and we finally did it! Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus & Butterfly were officially announced with a trailer back in [b]September 2021[/b] during [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iYCrI-GbJzA]the Indie Houses Direct.[/url] The new episode is considered as a standalone title that will be released on PC and consoles. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0qCE1S4i90s
[i]The announcement was kinda unexpected, but the community loves it![/i]

Did you hear of the Freya plush Campaign few months ago? The campaign ended with a success and [url=https://twitter.com/coffeetalk_game/status/1479105484347121665] and 305 Freya plushies were  sent across the world![/url] A very huge thanks to [url=https://www.makeship.com/products/freya-plush]Makeship[/url] for supporting the campaign back in [b]October 2021. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/af4da18eda2d90d058d17d0207fa7f580bb4b8e6.png[/img]
[i]The initial design back in 2020 (left) and the final design 2021 (right) for the Freya plush.[/i]

[h2]Coffee Talk in 2022 and beyond. [/h2]

Our journey is not over yet, there's still much to do! There are many exciting events and updates to be expected this year. Let's hope for the best and look forward to the next Episode of Coffee Talk! Once again, please take care of us this year as well~

On this second anniversary, we have another wonderful gift for you all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/8f7e9bab748e40c1ee2db1b4ead6a37ac6dd8ebf.png[/img]

[b]The Coffee Talk - 2 Years Anniversary Wallpaper is free to download![/b] 
You can get them in a [url=https://bit.ly/ct-anniv2022]better resolution for desktop and phone.[/url] Much thanks to [url=https://twitter.com/locoberi01]Locoberi[/url] to create this special anniversary wallpaper!

notes.title: Coffee Talk 1st Anniversary!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone! [/h2]
It's been a year since our launch, time sure flies isn't it? Looking back, 2020 wasn't the best year overall but it's definitely one special year for us where Coffee Talk officially launched and many things happened over the year that made us here to this point.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/98fbec65a30196dcf011510218a94c21065349e1.jpg[/img]
[i]Special Coffee Talk art by [url=https://twitter.com/i_am_dio]Dio Mahesa[/url] [/i]

It sure was fun looking back! But we're not quite done yet, in fact, we're going stronger than ever in 2021 thanks to everyone's support. Without beating around the bush now let's get into the good news shall we?

[h2]Voice Over and Localization mod [/h2]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/8525d05022f317fc6a1ce74bbdb6ce342d1e1126.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/8525d05022f317fc6a1ce74bbdb6ce342d1e1126.gif[/img][/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/914800/view/2926741189446574313]Last month's[/url] feature that was exclusive in the public beta branch is now available in the main game! You can check our  [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1_WBly7TGa7bG9Nqy6ASdzq0_y3dirEE8RH8nKxWgbI8/]tutorial[/url] on how to set up the mod or even create your own voice over and language dialogue into the game! 

This all started when we saw dedicated fans on Youtube doing voice over of our games and it has inspired us to create this modding tool for you!

[h2]More merch is a plus-h!~[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/103ea731e0c25b246589ff839b296d89affdf09a.png[/img]
[i]These cute photos are taken by [url=https://twitter.com/rideka_sama]rideka-sama[/url][/i]

That looks really adorable, isn't it? We plan to add a plushie as the newest addition to our merchandises line-up, and we have Freya's plushie for a starter. Follow our [url=https://twitter.com/coffeetalk_game]Twitter[/url] for future updates and future teaser regarding the plushie!

[h2]Join the fun in color![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/7b447c54166441aa2e342895a0cfe947e419467d.png[/img]

If you're feeling creative, you can also [url=http://bit.ly/ct-coloringpage]download[/url] and draw on our coloring page template. Be sure to share with us on [url=https://twitter.com/togeproductions/status/1354433579996966918]Twitter[/url]!

Last but not least, we are really thankful to everyone for everyone being part in our game community. we hope and looking forward to another year with you guys.❤️

Cheers,

Cofee Talk Team.

notes.title: Coffee Talk Voice Over and Localization Mod Available in Public Beta!
notes.content:
We have a modding feature available now on Coffee Talk!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/30a5341b86b9af908bb95e81cdbb720be6cdd3f2.png[/img]

We saw dedicated fans on Youtube doing voice over of our games and it has inspired us to create this modding tool for you! 

Since this is only available as Public Beta version, we want to remind you first that before you subscribe any Workshop item to play the mod, you need to change the game version:
[list]
[*] Go to Coffee Talk Properties
[*] Go to Betas tab
[*] Under the dropdown list, choose “[b]Public Beta-testing Purpose[/b]”
[*] Update the game and run
[/list]
The modding tool is then available for all players of Coffee Talk! You can download the modding tool by accessing the “Tools” category in your Steam Library. 

Once you have downloaded the modding tool, please follow the instructions according to the [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1_WBly7TGa7bG9Nqy6ASdzq0_y3dirEE8RH8nKxWgbI8/edit?usp=sharing]tutorial[/url] to get your mods going.

Warning: please be aware of the many bugs that may show up during your attempts. Please do notify us on our official Twitter account @coffeetalk_game or on our Discord at discord.gg/toge. Feel free to give us more and more feedback to improve the modding system!

If you want to test out one of the available mods go check our Coffee Talk Workshop out here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/914800/workshop/. You can also subscribe to the workshop to try other available voice overs.

We would also like to put out our disclaimer that any voice mod does not belong to Toge Productions or Coffee Talk and we are not responsible for any of the mods resulted by this modding tool in the Workshop.

We can’t wait to see how everybody’s individual mods will turn out!

notes.title: Coffee Talk Devlog #4: Brewing the Gameplay Mechanics and Latte Art Feature
notes.content:
What makes Coffee Talk different from other visual novels out there? The immersive coffee-making experience, of course.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33359823/a683635ed0593201506dd432a4a852c9873d5a4a.png[/img]

In Coffee Talk, you will play the role of a barista, who run your own cafe that opens at night. There, you will meet people (mostly non-human) and serve them warm drinks — just like what you would expect in a coffee shop. As you help them soothe their souls with a cup of warm drink or two, stories will be unveiled.

•••

In Coffee Talk’s initial stage of development, there has been a continuous debate about how players should enjoy the game. Unlike other games from Toge Productions that are mechanics-heavy, Coffee Talk’s [url=https://togeproductions.itch.io/project-green-tea-latte]prototype[/url] was a straight-up visual novel with minimum gameplay. To make it become more of a “game”, the team then experimented more on the game mechanics.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33359823/1a917feed135302de9fe56b5e58db1cde944910d.gif[/img]

Before, the branching and brewing mechanics were pretty straightforward with predetermined combinations, and players were not able to see whether they made the right drink or not before serving it. However, in the newer version, the game automatically generates the name, visuals, and stats of the beverages, which then became the key to the branching mechanism — it will be further covered in this log.

Read more about the history of Coffee Talk here:  [url=https://togeproductions.itch.io/coffee-talk/devlog/44272/devlog-1-how-the-game-came-to-be-the-seed-the-anxiety-and-the-belief-of-design-by-subtraction]Devlog #1: How the game came to be - The seed, the anxiety, and the belief of design by subtraction[/url]

•••

[h1]Prototype Version vs. Newer Version[/h1]

Even until today, the gameplay mechanics are still being improved. To understand more about that matter, we are going to need the experts in the field. For that reason, I invited [url=https://twitter.com/fredriklauw]Fredrik Lauwrensius[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/FujiwaraLunasa]Jovan Anggara[/url], the programmers of Coffee Talk as the special guests for this development log!

Both of them joined the team at a different time. While Jovan has been involved ever since the making of the prototype version — which was during the 2017 game jam, Fredrik came aboard about 1–2 weeks later, after some intense discussion about the game mechanism, direction, and so forth. There were many questions lingering for quite some time about Coffee Talk’s game mechanics when this log is still in draft form. Due to me being a complete noob on programming stuff, they are luckily kind enough to explain in a simple way.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33359823/0e3db44b4fbb9bcbd841d525df275d6e0e8f35f6.gif[/img]
 
Jovan told me that in the game jam version, players can freely add any ingredients for a drink. However, it resulted in a massive amount of beverages combinations that could be made, with most of it categorized as “failed” drinks. The team then decided that there should be no failed drink, and therefore tried to limit the possibility of combinations by determining certain ingredients to be used at certain times.

Other than that, players were also able to make cold drinks by adding ice before. The feature was eliminated and a brand new drink statistics was set up. Now the barista will only serve warm drinks containing these 4 statuses: warm/cool/sweet/bitter — because some drinks can tastes sweet and bitter at the same time, and the sensations of warmness and coolness can be experienced at just split seconds apart. The statistics, according to Fredrik and Jovan, affects the branching mechanics where it could cause not only changes in dialogue but also in the later parts of the game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33359823/ca2eee290c3bf76feec5af8637ede85b2c1448ac.png[/img]
[i]Sneak peek: the newest brewing UI that is currently under development[/i]

•••

[h1]Art in a Cup: Additional yet Significant Feature[/h1]

What is it that could complement a nice, warm drink? We are thinking that latte art would be a nice touch. In Coffee Talk, in addition to serving drinks, players can also add their own latte art for milk-based beverages (or any beverages that use milk as an ingredient). The idea of the feature first came from our beloved CEO, [url=https://twitter.com/kerissakti/status/1097699471457058816]Kris Antoni[/url]. It was not long after I joined Toge Productions that I saw the whole studio burst with enthusiasm toward this particular feature.

Frederik and Jovan said that it took them about a week to make that feature from scratch. Initially, they paid more attention to what the players can do in the development, such as pouring the milk and etching, until they studied the [i]real[/i] latte art… from youtube videos. As time goes by, after many trials, they realized that they should also pay attention to fluid simulation — in short, the consistency and the flow of milk when it is poured.

“The biggest challenge would be to find the right configuration between the consistency of both the drink and the milk,” they said to me after thinking for quite some time. “Aside from it, we also need to think about optimization for this feature because it takes up loads of performance.”

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33359823/ec9d3a90d61f8b1047ceb24589cc67da3677cf98.gif[/img]
 
The game mechanics and latte art feature have been revamped several times until today, even the programmers have lost count. You can give support to the developers by playing the demo and adding it to your wishlist here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/914800/Coffee_Talk/

Also, don't forget to follow Coffee Talk’s [url=https://twitter.com/coffeetalk_game]twitter[/url] for more updates!

Thank you for reading! ☕
